summary: Data centers are not a permitted or conditional use in any zoning district.
notes: Ordinance adopted 2026-09-23; effective date not stated. Removal of the TM district is still pending. The existing Middletown data center predates the ban.

summary: New data centers need a Special Exception where they were previously allowed by right.
notes: Applications accepted before 2025-02-12 may proceed by right under the grandfathering resolution. The disputed 2026 pause on Board votes does not change the category.

summary: New data centers need a special exception and are limited to the PCID district, which exists only at Vint Hill.
notes: Exempt: existing PCID data centers, PCID site plans filed by 2026-08-20, Vint Hill Land Bay V projects, and land zoned Business Park on 2026-08-20. Those are grandfathered, not open to new applicants.

summary: By right in C-3, C-4, and I-2 to I-6 under size caps (none in I-5 or I-6) and distance standards; larger or closer needs a special exception.
notes: Distance standards: 200 ft from residential lot lines, 1 mile from Metro entrances.

summary: By right only on overlay parcels that meet one of five eligibility pathways; elsewhere a Special Use Permit is required.
notes: The overlay is closed to new map additions and its last eligibility window ends 2026-12-21, so in practice it may work closer to Board approval only after that date.

summary: By right in the M-2 heavy industrial district and the ICTP overlay, under 750-ft setbacks and other standards.
notes: A 2025 amendment to require a conditional use permit in M-2 failed. The Board may modify setbacks in a rezoning.

summary: By right in the Culpeper Technology Zone; a conditional use permit is required on other industrial land.
notes: Weak basis: one advocacy source, no county record read. The same source says the Board later removed by-right status in all districts, which would make this approval_only; unverified.

summary: Data center standards adopted in 2026; whether data centers are by right was not determined.
Data centers are not a permissible use anywhere in the town.
notes: Adopted 2025-07-08. Does not affect Amazon's 2023 special use permit, which is in litigation.
